$comment: The upstream pin. This is the only place the ECC version is declared. Bumping it is a one-line change; see UPSTREAM.md for the review discipline.

sources.$comment: Where custom/ content came from. Recorded so a later move to a shared org is a one-line edit here, not a hunt through the repo.

custom-skills.portNotes: 81 skills vendored by copy; 38 pruned on 2026-08-29 as off-domain (dbt, Terraform provider authoring, Packer/AWS/Azure, React Native, code-review fragments) — see CHANGELOG. 43 remain from this source, tracked in custom/skills/skills-lock.json. Canonical storage upstream is .agents/skills/ (the per-harness .claude/.codex/.gemini directories there are generated, not sources). custom/skills/ additionally holds custom-deep-research, which is ours, not from this source.

custom-skills-academic.portNotes: 8 of 23 skills vendored by copy, 7 remaining (research-lookup pruned 2026-08-29: the most expensive description in the bundle at 1,138 chars, needs a paid Parallel/Perplexity key, and paper-search plus literature-review cover it), byte-identical, into custom/skills/ alongside the ai-skills-library set (same module, custom-skills). Taken: research-grants, scientific-writing, literature-review, peer-review, citation-management, scholar-evaluation, scientific-critical-thinking. Deliberately NOT taken: the clinical set (clinical-decision-support, clinical-reports, treatment-plans) and the presentation/marketing set (generate-image, infographics, market-research-reports, latex-posters, pptx-posters, scientific-slides, scientific-schematics, venue-templates, document-skills, markitdown, parallel-web, hypothesis-generation) — wrong domain for this group and pure per-session context cost. No name collisions with upstream ECC or the existing custom skills. Each carries Python helper scripts under scripts/; no hardcoded credentials found on audit.

notConsidered.reason: CC BY-NC 4.0, incompatible with redistributing under this repo's Apache-2.0, and ambiguous for a university that also does industry-funded contract research. Yields only 4 skills — its 40k stars are for the surrounding plugin, which this overlay does not install — and its deep-research collides with both upstream ECC's and our custom-deep-research. The K-Dense set above covers the same ground under MIT. Decided 2026-07-30.

custom-research.portNotes: The skill is renamed to custom-deep-research: upstream ECC ships an unrelated skill also called deep-research. The command's `ultrawork:` line is dropped — it is an oh-my-openagent keyword with no meaning in any target harness. Otherwise byte-identical.

atlassian-agent.portNotes: Not vendored. Referenced as an MCP server, run with `uvx --from git+<repo>@<sha> atlassian-agent-mcp` — the package declares that console script, so no clone is needed. Pinned to a SHA because it is not on PyPI and this repo never tracks a moving branch. Bump deliberately: change the sha here and the matching one in overlay/manifest-overlay.json, then re-run make mcp.
